attributes.company_request_neutral_meaning: A request for nonpublic information relating to the Company or any Company Subsidiary, or for access to the properties, books or records of the Company or any Company Subsidiary, that in the Company Board’s good-faith judgment would reasonably be expected to give rise to or result in a Company Acquisition Proposal.

excerpts.exact_text: (c)The Company shall promptly (and in no event later than twenty-four (24) hours after receipt) notify Parent (which notice shall be provided orally and in writing and shall identify the Person making the Company Acquisition Proposal or request for nonpublic information relating to the Company or any Subsidiary of the Company or for access to the properties, books or records of the Company or any Subsidiary of the Company that, in the Company Board’s good faith judgment, would reasonably be expected to give rise to or result in a Company Acquisition Proposal (“Company Request”) and, in each case, set forth in reasonable detail the material terms thereof and of any modification thereto) after receipt of any Company Acquisition Proposal or any Company Request, and shall promptly (and in no event later than twenty-four (24) hours after receipt) provide copies to Parent of any written Company Requests, proposals or indications of interest with respect to such Company Acquisition Proposal, and/or draft agreements relating to such Company Acquisition Proposal.
